description.en_US: Agentic non-linear video editor with scoped media intelligence, evidence-backed edit proposals, deterministic timeline editing, reviewable captions, versioning, and browser or Sandbox Job export.
description.zh_Hans: 智能非线性视频剪辑应用，支持作用域媒体内容理解、证据化剪辑提案、确定性时间线编辑、可审阅字幕、版本管理以及浏览器或 Sandbox Job 导出。
